title: SML 0.6.2 is out
intro: The library (swsml 0.6.2) and the CLI (smltools 0.2.1, its first release under the new name) are live; the VS Code extension is 0.4.2.
items: A full error-code system: 137 codes, carried by all five implementations and the CLI. This site now has an error-code lookup with wildcards (E-CONTRACT-*) and deep links (#E-PARSE-008).

include / import aligned across all five implementations: import "x.sml" semantics fixed (no longer wrapped in a namespace); JS gained glob-include, dotted module names (import ui.buttons) and re: restricted regex.

Silent passes now fail with a code in all five implementations (unterminated strings, unknown escapes, top-level scalars, ...). Several of them used to return a wrong tree; a leading BOM is now skipped everywhere.
Security fixes: a forged include inside a block comment no longer reads files; C out-of-bounds writes when err=NULL; the nesting-depth guard can no longer be bypassed in C / C++.
smltools gained --from xml (CMSIS-SVD files can be read directly) and --to html.
VS Code extension 0.4.2: fixes "the extension never activated on VS Code 1.13x" and "no SML command showed up in the command palette", and adds as ns namespace navigation.
